english.title: In business sell / supply investigational medicinal product for use in a clinical trial in breach of conditions

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Medicines for Human Use Clinical Trials Regulations 2004

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business carried on by you,

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[supplied]_

an investigational medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MEDICINAL PRODUCT..), to

(C)_[an investigator, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..),]_
(D)_[a health care professional, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), who was a member of an investigator's team]_
(E)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), who provided health care under the direction or control of an investigator]_
(F)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), who was to provide health care under the direction or control of an investigator]_
(G)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), who provided health care under the direction or control of a health care professional who was a member of an investigator's team]_
(H)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), who was to provide health care under the direction or control of a health care professional who was a member of an investigator's team]_
(I)_[a subject, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..),]_

for the purpose of administering that product in a clinical trial without the conditions specified regulation 13(2) of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 being satisfied
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(1), 49(1)(b) and 52 of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 49 of the of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 makes a breach of reg 13 an offence.
(ii) Regulation 51 of the of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 provides that a person does not commit an offence under these Regulations if he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of that offence. Where evidence is adduced which is sufficient to raise an issue with respect to that defence, the court or jury shall assume that the defence is satisfied unless the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that it is not.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
